scopeQualification.note: Only the exact Wall 1-4 scoped evidence is dispositioned. The shared staged-art report's unrelated failures are preserved and are not converted into a global PASS.

provenanceQualification.recordingRule: The active Art Factory runbook requires exact model/revision when exposed and explicitly requires null rather than invention when a runtime cannot expose a parameter. Producer evidence records these values as null with that limitation; this review does not infer or fabricate them.

reviews.name: School Star Poster
reviews.reason: Exact rendered pixels are unmistakably a physical wall-mounted framed poster: substantial wood frame thickness/bevel, glazed-paper inset, visible top hanging loops, wall contact shadow, and dimensional corner construction. Garden Glow leaf/star identity is exact and remains legible at card size. It is attractive but appropriately restrained for Tier 1 and does not materially duplicate the later Skate Poster or other Wall silhouettes.

reviews.name: Cloud Wall Flag
reviews.reason: Exact rendered pixels clearly read as a suspended textile wall flag rather than a flat icon: woven cloth texture, stitched hems, fold curvature, dowel/end hardware, braided hanging cord and wall shadow create real mounting depth. Crescent/cloud/night imagery strongly matches Galaxy Glow and the silhouette remains immediately readable in the small card. Complexity is suitable for Tier 1 and the pennant construction is distinct from every other current Wall item.

reviews.name: Pixel Scoreboard
reviews.reason: Exact rendered pixels establish a thick molded wall scoreboard with rounded housing, side depth, fasteners/mount details, recessed dark glass/display face and a clear wall shadow. Sunny Pop yellow/coral/aqua pixels and sun/star motifs remain strong at card size without collapsing into generic signage. Tier 1 treatment is simple and polished, and the physical housing/screen layout is materially distinct from Neon City Sign and the other Wall candidates.

reviews.name: Heart Gallery
reviews.reason: Exact rendered pixels read as a deliberately mounted multi-frame wall gallery: two thick metallic picture frames stand off a substantial backing plate and lower rail/bracket system, with consistent highlights and contact-depth cues. Aqua/white heart-wave artwork with restrained coral accents fits Aqua Wave, and the asymmetric two-frame silhouette survives card reduction. Its added layered construction is a credible Tier 2 step above the Tier 1 pieces and is sufficiently distinct from the generic four-panel Art Gallery Wall.
